summary: CRITICAL: Deliverable is incomplete and non-functional. Workflow references fixture files (fixtures/version-start.txt, commits-feat.txt, etc.) that don't exist — act will fail immediately at 'Stage a private working copy' step. Task explicitly requires: (1) test fixture files created, (2) test harness script to run act, capture output to act-result.txt, verify results — both missing. Python script itself is well-written (good error handling, clear logic, proper separation of concerns) but unusable without fixtures and harness. Missing required artifact: act-result.txt.
